transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble keeping up with work. I'm a teacher, and... well, I'll sit down with a stack of essays or a curriculum document, fully intending to get through them. But then, I don't know, maybe ten minutes go by and I realize I'm just staring at the exact same page. 

My mind is just... on three other things, and I haven't really taken in anything I'm looking at. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did you have similar trouble focusing when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I guess I did. I mean... looking back at primary school, my report cards usually said things like... "bright but careless." Or that I wouldn't finish my work unless someone was closely supervising me. And... my parents were always finding old worksheets crumpled up at the bottom of my backpack that I just... forgot to turn in. So... yes.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about different things, even when there isn't an immediate problem?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mean, I get stressed out when I'm behind on my grading, but... I don't just sit around worrying about things if there's no reason to. So... no.
Do you often feel restless or have trouble sitting still?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I sit for a lot of the day, grading and planning, and... I don't feel like I need to be moving around or anything. I just... my mind wanders, but I'm fine sitting still.
Were you like this across most activities as a child, or mainly with reading and schoolwork?
Um... I'm not really sure. I think... probably mainly schoolwork. I don't really remember how I was with other things.
Do you also have this same trouble focusing outside of reading and schoolwork, like in conversations, chores, or everyday tasks?

Um... yeah, I guess. In conversations, mostly. Like... in planning meetings at work, or even just talking with my wife. I'll be looking right at the person, just... nodding, but... then they'll ask what I think, and I realize I completely missed the actual point of what they just said. So... yeah, it happens then, too.
Do you often lose things you need for daily tasks, like your keys, phone, or important papers?

Um... yeah. A lot. I'm... always looking for stuff I need for work. Like my classroom keys, or... my lesson notes. Sometimes my USB drive. Even the whistle and cards I use when I ref games. It's just... I'll be sure I had them in my hand just a few minutes ago, and then... they're gone.
Do you often interrupt other people or blurt out answers before they finish asking the question?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I do that.
